About.title: EGY UNITED FOR ELEVATORS — Integrated solutions built around your project
About.description: An Egyptian company providing elevator supply and installation, modernization and replacement, fault repair, and monthly maintenance.
body: We serve residential buildings, villas, companies, malls, hospitals, and industrial and administrative facilities, and we consider the building and the project requirements when defining the right solution.
Service covers every governorate in Egypt, from defining the need and the site visit through execution and follow-up.
points: Supply and installation suited to the building.
Modernization of existing elevators and renewal of their components.
Repair of faults and technical problems.
Monthly maintenance to follow the elevator’s technical condition.
Coverage across all governorates of Egypt.

WhyChooseUs.title: Why choose EGY UNITED FOR ELEVATORS?

items.title: Solutions shaped around the project
items.text: We start from the building type and how it is used, then define the supply, installation, or modernization path that fits the request.

items.title: Installation and maintenance together
items.text: Supply, installation, repair, and monthly maintenance are all within the company’s services.

items.title: Care in how the work is carried out
items.text: We pay attention to execution details and elevator components according to the requirements of each project.

items.title: Modernization and replacement
items.text: Updating existing elevators and improving their components according to the needs of the building.

items.title: Coverage across Egypt
items.text: We provide our services in all governorates of Egypt.

items.title: Follow-up from the first conversation
items.text: We follow the request from the first contact through execution, and keep maintenance and repair available according to the service requested.

WorkProcess.title: Five steps from the first call to completion
WorkProcess.description: A clear path for supply, installation, modernization, repair, or maintenance.

items.title: Contact us
items.text: Call one of the company numbers, or send your details through the quote form on WhatsApp.

items.title: Define the project requirements
items.text: Building type, service type, and the number of elevators or the condition of the current one.

items.title: Site visit and assessment
items.text: Review of the building or the existing elevator to define the scope of work.

items.title: Submit the quotation
items.text: A quotation that sets out the supply or execution scope based on the visit and the project requirements.

items.title: Execution and follow-up
items.text: Carry out the agreed work, then follow up within the scope of the requested service.

FAQ.title: Straight answers before you get in touch

items.question: Do you install new elevators?
items.answer: Yes. We supply and install elevators for residential, commercial, industrial, and administrative buildings, according to the requirements of each project.

items.question: Are your services available in every governorate?
items.answer: Yes. EGY UNITED FOR ELEVATORS services are available in all governorates of Egypt.

items.question: Do you provide monthly maintenance?
items.answer: Yes. We provide monthly maintenance to help keep the elevator running properly and to follow its technical condition.

items.question: Can an older elevator be modernized?
items.answer: Yes. We modernize and replace existing elevators and update their components to suit the needs of the building.

items.question: How do I request a quotation?
items.answer: Fill in the quote form with your details and the request. A ready WhatsApp message will open for you to send. You can also call any of the company numbers directly.
